provenance: Original CC0 numeric fixtures. Projected expectations authored from lift/transfer equations without executing the runtime.
scope: Static vertical solid faces, one upper local grip point, registered horizontal top, rectangular approach. Exact adjacency; nonascending grab; hand reach in WU. No animation-derived displacement.
resources: If a wall pool exists, grab and each climb tick consume one stamina; landing resets the pool. No wall pool means no stamina coefficient in the ledge schema. Other resources follow the underlying adapters.
schedule: One stationary grab tick. climbTicks-1 vertical lift ticks with integer interpolation; final horizontal transfer by the full body width; full sweep/clearance each tick. Release toward/Up cancels without reset.
